The composition follows the country’s east-to-west geography rather than presenting an isolated block of colour. The Caribbean islands and the narrow southern land bridge extend the image beyond the main northern landmass. Dark blue water frames the Mediterranean side. Portugal and nearby land remain visible but are less prominent than the highlighted Spanish areas. This creates a different emphasis from the broader, evenly presented Iberian view in the other Spain image.
